items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: So it’s myself, Eric Krasno, Neil Evans and the other members who are rhythm guitar player Adam Smirnoff

ctx.x: Yeah. Like Eric Krasno, the guitar player is in both. Neil Evans is the keyboardist in Soulive, and is now a member of Lettuce. The only person that isn’t there is Alan the drummer. So it’s myself, Eric Krasno, Neil Evans and the other members who are rhythm guitar player Adam Smirnoff, and the bass player from California, his name is Eric Coomes.
So who books these bands? You have an agency?
